name: BEFORE_STATE generic - differently
answer: People used to meet differently, but now they use technology, and I think the change is good.
expectedBehavior: Treat the attempted but unspecified earlier state as GENERIC and target BEFORE_STATE.

name: BEFORE_STATE generic - different way
answer: People communicated in a different way before, but now they mostly use messaging apps. I think this change is useful because it is faster.
expectedBehavior: Ask what the earlier communication method actually was.

name: BEFORE_STATE generic - were different
answer: Relationships were different in the past, but now friends use video calls. I think this is positive because they can stay in touch.
expectedBehavior: Treat 'were different' as an attempted but non-learnable earlier state.

name: BEFORE_STATE generic - another way
answer: People used to do things another way, but now they send messages online. I think this is positive because communication is quicker.
expectedBehavior: Target the unspecified earlier method rather than completing the answer.

name: BEFORE_STATE generic - not the same
answer: Before technology, communication was not the same, but now people use group chats. I think this is good because distance matters less.
expectedBehavior: Require an identifiable earlier communication state.

name: BEFORE_STATE concrete - in-person meetings
answer: People used to meet in person, but now they often use messages and video calls. I think this change is mostly positive because it helps people stay connected across long distances.
expectedBehavior: Accept the identifiable earlier method without demanding extra detail.

name: BEFORE_STATE concrete - landline calls
answer: In the past, families called each other on landlines, but now they use group chats every day. I think the change is positive because sharing news is faster.
expectedBehavior: Accept landline calls as concrete BEFORE_STATE evidence.

name: BEFORE_STATE concrete - face-to-face planning
answer: Friends used to arrange meetings face to face, but now they make plans through messaging apps. I like this change because it saves time.
expectedBehavior: Accept a brief but distinguishable earlier method.

name: BEFORE_STATE concrete - letters
answer: People once waited for letters, but now they can send instant messages. I think this is a positive change because communication is much faster.
expectedBehavior: Accept letters as concrete BEFORE_STATE evidence.

name: BEFORE_STATE concrete - office discussions
answer: Coworkers used to hold most discussions in person, but now they use video meetings. I think this is useful because remote teams can work together.
expectedBehavior: Accept in-person discussions as concrete BEFORE_STATE evidence.

name: REASON generic - nice
answer: My favorite color is blue because it is nice.
expectedBehavior: Treat 'because it is nice' as a circular generic reason.

name: REASON generic - good
answer: My favorite color is green because it is good.
expectedBehavior: Ask for a concrete cause, effect, or association.

name: REASON generic - really nice
answer: I like red because it is really nice.
expectedBehavior: Do not count an intensified evaluation as a concrete reason.

name: REASON generic - like it
answer: My favorite color is black because I like it.
expectedBehavior: Treat a restatement of preference as GENERIC REASON evidence.

name: REASON generic - great color
answer: I prefer yellow because it is a great color.
expectedBehavior: Require information beyond a generic positive evaluation.

name: REASON concrete - ocean association
answer: My favorite color is blue because it reminds me of the ocean.
expectedBehavior: Accept a brief personal association as a concrete reason.

name: REASON concrete - calm effect
answer: I like green because it makes me feel calm.
expectedBehavior: Accept a concrete emotional effect as REASON evidence.

name: REASON concrete - energy effect
answer: Red is my favorite color because it gives me energy.
expectedBehavior: Accept a concrete personal effect as REASON evidence.

name: REASON concrete - clothing benefit
answer: I prefer black because it matches most of my clothes.
expectedBehavior: Accept a concrete practical benefit as REASON evidence.

name: REASON concrete - sunlight association
answer: My favorite color is yellow because it reminds me of sunlight.
expectedBehavior: Accept a distinguishable association as REASON evidence.

name: PLACE generic - nice area
answer: I live in a nice area.
expectedBehavior: Treat an evaluation without a location as GENERIC PLACE evidence.

name: PLACE generic - somewhere nearby
answer: I live somewhere nearby.
expectedBehavior: Treat an unanchored relative place as GENERIC.

name: PLACE generic - good place
answer: I live in a good place.
expectedBehavior: Require a recognizable location rather than an evaluation.

name: PLACE generic - around here
answer: I live around here.
expectedBehavior: Treat an unanchored deictic place as GENERIC.

name: PLACE generic - place I like
answer: I live in a place I like.
expectedBehavior: Do not count a preference statement as an identifiable location.

name: PLACE concrete - western Seoul
answer: I live in western Seoul.
expectedBehavior: Accept a short but recognizable location.

name: PLACE concrete - Busan park
answer: I live near a small park in Busan.
expectedBehavior: Accept a city plus landmark as concrete PLACE evidence.

name: PLACE concrete - Han River neighborhood
answer: I live in a quiet neighborhood near the Han River.
expectedBehavior: Accept a recognizable landmark reference as PLACE evidence.

name: PLACE concrete - Incheon apartment
answer: I live in an apartment in Incheon.
expectedBehavior: Accept a city and dwelling reference as concrete PLACE evidence.

name: PLACE concrete - outside Daejeon
answer: I live in a small town outside Daejeon.
expectedBehavior: Accept a relative location anchored to a named city.
